rationale: Re-freeze review (2026-10-20, fresh independent Opus review against the current generation; decision content verified byte-identical to the previously reviewed decision apart from the evidence pin). Held EO 9593 (10 FR 9379) directs War Department seizure and operation of Springfield Plywood Corp. plants; para. 5 ends possession on a Secretary determination (not held). Held EO 9603 orders that all property taken under the listed orders, expressly including 'No. 9593 of July 25, 1945', 'shall be returned to the owners thereof as soon as practicable', and amends listed orders to the extent of conflict. Since the order's only operation is the seizure, a direction to return all property taken under it ends every operative part. My status NO. Defect noted, status stands: 9603 fixes no end date and uses 'amended' rather than 'revoked'; the first-end date is not adjudicated. D6: no held order after Aug. 25, 1945 names 9593; no re-seizure, extension or exception. Accept.
